text: For the director. According to Yonath elem rehoqim. [1] A miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him at Gath. [AA]
I Have mercy on me, God,for I am treated harshly;attackers press me all the day.
My foes treat me harshly all the day;yes, many are my attackers.O Most High,
when I am afraid,in you I place my trust.
I praise the word of God;I trust in God, I do not fear. [AB]What can mere flesh do to me? [AC]
II All the day they foil my plans;their every thought is of evil against me.
They hide together in ambush;they watch my every step;they lie in wait for my life. [AD]
They are evil; watch them, God!Cast the nations down in your anger!
My wanderings you have noted;are my tears not stored in your flask, [2]recorded in your book? [AE]
My foes turn back when I call on you.This I know: God is on my side.
I praise the word of God,I praise the word of the Lord.
In God I trust, I do not fear.What can man do to me?
III I have made vows to you, God;with offerings I will fulfill them, [AF]
For you have snatched me from death,kept my feet from stumbling,That I may walk before Godin the light of the living.
